name: إيجاد القيمة الصغرى في قائمة
description: اكتب برنامجاً يعثر على القيمة الصغرى في قائمة.
code:
#Khatwa 1: Taerif wa ibtida' al-qaimah
values = [5, 8, 4, 78, 95, 12, 1, 0, 6, 35, 46]
#Khatwa 2: Eayyin al-qimah al-ula li takoon al-qimah al-sughra hatta al-an
min_value = values[0]
#Khatwa 3: Itereer ibr al-qiyam al-mutabaqiyah fi al-qaimah wa qarrir ayyuhuma huwa al-aqall
for i in range(1, len(values)): 
    #Khatwa 3.1: Tahaqqaq iza kana al-ansar 'inda al-index i hiya al-qimah al-sughra hatta al-an
    if (values[i] < min_value):
        min_value = values[i]
#Khatwa 4: Itba' al-qimah al-sughra fi al-qaimah
print("Al-qimah al-sughra:", min_value)

untr_name: Finding the Minimum Value in a List
untr_description: Write a program that finds the minimum value in a list.
untr_code:
#Step 1: Define and initialize the list
values = [5, 8, 4, 78, 95, 12, 1, 0, 6, 35, 46]
#Step 2: Set the first value to be the minimum value so far.
min_value = values[0]
#Step 3: Iterate through the remaining values in the list and decide which one is the minimum value 
for i in range(1, len(values)): 
    # Step 3.1: Determine if the element at index i is the minimum value so far
    if (values[i] < min_value):
        min_value = values[i]
#Step 4: Print the minimum value in the list
print("Minimum value:", min_value)
